verdict.rationale: Evidence shows static Remote Control API HTTP/WebSocket reference docs (unreal-docs-24, unreal-docs-25) but nothing indicating an interactive, runnable-example API explorer (e.g., a Swagger-style try-it console or live code sandbox). Probe evidence further shows docs are served as static HTML SPA shells not amenable to interactive/agentic exploration, and no official MCP or API-explorer tooling exists.
